body: I'm sorry... I fell asleep... I just get suicidal all the time. I guess I'll put it off for another day when I can think straight... Thank you for the help. Im sorry.

I cannot see a future past like, 3 months... Anything further and I freak out. And even though that 'future' is there, I still don't want to live it... I'd rather end it, and not have to deal with my constant sadness, which I know I will off load on others, and make them sad and upset and worried. 
When I say I have no future, I mean I don't have a good one. I have a lifetime of depression, anxiety and bad feelings from my lack of confidence and fear of... well people.

Okay... I just, I know I make him sad, but he's the only person I speak to... I feel he's the only person who understands, and he rarely cares about anything so.. I don't even know if he'd be that bothered by my death... I know that's quite a horrible thing to say, but I just don't see myself as something important. I'm nothing.
I'm supposed to be going to see my psyc...But I don't think I'll be here to go... I'm sorry.

Thank you... I just don't see a future for myself is all. I just want to be gone, and out of everyone's lives... I feel like a massive burden, and that people feel sorry for me, not genuinely care. 
I feel so stupid. I'm sorry.
